source:
Double-click an item from one of the lists,
or copy and paste an item from in game
(hover over the item and Ctrl+C) to view or edit
the item and add it to your build. You can
also clone an item within Path of Building by
copying and pasting it with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V.

You can Control + Click an item to equip it, or
drag it onto the slot.  This will also add it to
your build if it's from the unique/template list.
If there's 2 slots an item can go in,
holding Shift will put it in the second.

source:
Controls how the base damage for applying Ailments is calculated:
	Average: damage is based on the average application, including both crits and non-crits
	Crits Only: damage is based solely on Ailments inflicted with crits
display:
控制如何计算异常状态的基础伤害: 平均: damage is based on the average application, including both crits and non-crits
	仅暴击：伤害计算只基于暴击产生的异常状态

source:
Controls how the cooldown for skills is calculated:
	Base: The cooldown is calculated with normal behavior.
	Average: The cooldown is adjusted to reflect the average time between uses, factoring in effects such as a chance to not consume a cooldown.
display:
控制技能冷却时间的计算方式: 基础: The cooldown is calculated with normal behavior.
    平均模式:冷却时间被调整为技能使用间隔的平均时间，并考虑概率不消耗冷却时间等效果.

source:
Controls how modifiers which choose a random element will function.
	Average: Modifiers will grant one third of their value to Fire, Cold, and Lightning simultaneously
	Fire / Cold / Lightning: Modifiers will grant their full value as the specified element
If a modifier chooses between just two elements, the full value can only be given as those two elements.
display:
控制选择随机元素的修正的运作。
	平均: Modifiers will grant one third of their value to 火焰, 冰霜, and 闪电 simultaneously
	火焰 / 冰霜 / 闪电: Modifiers will grant their full value as the specified element
如果修正只在两个元素之间进行选择，则只能给出这两个元素的完整值。

source:
Controls how Life regeneration is calculated:
	Minimum: does not include burst regen
	Average: includes burst regen, averaged based on uptime
	Burst: includes full burst regen
display:
Controls how 生命 regeneration is calculated:
	最小值：不计算瞬时回复
	平均：包括瞬时回复，基于生效时间进行平均计算
	瞬时：包括完整的瞬时回复

source:
Controls how resource on hit/kill is calculated:
	Minimum: does not include chances
	Average: includes chance gains, averaged based on uptime
	Maximum: treats all chances as certain
display:
控制如何计算命中/击杀获取的资源: 最小值: does not include chances
	平均：计算几率收益，平均基于正常生效时间
	最大值将几率视为必然

source:
Controls how Defending with Double Armour is calculated:
	Minimum: never Defend with Double Armour
	Average: Damage Reduction from Defending with Double Armour is proportional to chance
	Maximum: always Defend with Double Armour
This setting has no effect if you have 100% chance to Defend with Double Armour.
display:
控制如何计算使用双倍护甲防御: 最小值: never Defend with Double Armour

source:
This controls the calculation of the stats shown in this tab.
The stats in the sidebar are always shown in Effective DPS mode, regardless of this setting.

Unbuffed: No auras, buffs, or other support skills or effects will apply. This is equivalent to standing in town.
Buffed: Aura and buff skills apply. This is equivalent to standing in your hideout with auras and buffs turned on.
In Combat: Charges and combat buffs such as Onslaught will also apply. This will show your character sheet stats in combat.
Effective DPS: Curses and enemy properties (such as resistances and status conditions) will also apply. This estimates your true DPS.

无增益效果: 无光环丶增益效果丶其他辅助技能效果影响。等效于站在城镇地图中时的状态。
有增益效果: 受到光环丶增益效果影响。等效于站在藏身处中时的状态。
战斗状态: 受到充能球和战斗BUFF如【猛攻】的影响。这将表现你的人物在战斗中的统计数据。
有效 DPS: 受到诅咒和敌人属性(例如敌人的抗性和状态条件)影响。这表现了估算出的你的真实DPS。

Double-click an item from one of the lists,
or copy and paste an item from in game
(hover over the item and Ctrl+C) to view or edit
the item and add it to your build. You can
also clone an item within Path of Building by
copying and pasting it with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V.

drag it onto the slot.  This will also add it to
your build if it's from the unique/template list.
If there's 2 slots an item can go in,
holding Shift will put it in the second.
